comparison.objective: Screw in an LED bulb, seat a shade, and verify that the lamp lights; candidate adjusts and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Threaded component insertion, shade placement, and switch actuation versus setscrew tool use, fine collar calibration, and guarded cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Lamp assembled and illuminated versus repeated non-bottoming deceleration and post-lock retention; board setup and scoring are missing.
comparison.reason: Switch pressing and rotation are generic subskills; the central assembly and functional outcomes differ.
